items.name: Saltwolf's Arm-Ring
items.lore: Won from Hersir Ketil Saltwolf when The Longships were thrown back.

items.name: Fetch Lantern
items.lore: Won from the Grey Man's Fetch when Fetch-Night was ended. It shows you who's behind you.

items.name: Wrecker's Lantern
items.lore: Won from the Wrecker-Chief when The Wreckers' Lights were put out. Its light only shines toward the sea.

items.name: Kelp-Maned Bridle
items.lore: Won from the Kelp-Maned Stallion when The Aughisky Run was ended. Still wet.

items.name: Fomhor the Cliff Chief's Cloak
items.lore: Won from Fomhor the Cliff Chief when the Cliff Dwellers' Hold was broken. Smells of gull and smoke.

items.name: Fog Banshee's Girdle
items.lore: Won from the Fog Banshee when the beacon was cleared. Damp, always.

items.name: Great Distorter's Belt
items.lore: Won from the Great Distorter at the rift. The buckle never looks quite straight.

items.name: Koalinth Tidecaller's Wristguard
items.lore: Won from the koalinth tidecaller. Shell and sinew; it hums when the tide turns.
